subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should this PR make Anthropic OAuth fail closed for non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values and send derived loopback redirect URIs, despite the shipped env compatibility change and no live provider-token proof for every allowed host spelling?
rationale: The code path is a narrow, well-tested hardening fix, but it changes a shipped env behavior and the security report's attacker model depends on process-environment control that SECURITY.md treats as trusted host/operator control.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback validation and derived redirect URI because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Anthropic exchange using the allowed redirect spellings before accepting provider registration risk.

options.title: Pause For Broader Auth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer removing or deprecating the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it now.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback validation and derived redirect URI because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and has the strongest recent Anthropic OAuth/security decision history in the inspected code path.
